events.title: Santa’s Arrival in Old Town
events.addr: Old Town Square, Fort Collins, CO 80524
events.blurb: Santa arrives downtown Friday at 11:30 a.m. and opens Santa’s Workshop in Old Town Square, where visits are free through Dec. 24.
events.blurbEs: Santa llega al centro el viernes a las 11:30 a. m. y abre Santa’s Workshop en Old Town Square, donde las visitas son gratis hasta el 24 de diciembre.
events.getThere: Free downtown parking on weekends and holidays.

events.title: Holiday Artisan Market
events.blurb: About 100 local artisans and crafters sell handmade gifts at the city’s annual holiday market.
events.blurbEs: Unos 100 artesanos locales venden regalos hechos a mano en el mercado navideño anual de la ciudad.

events.title: Dracula
events.addr: 417 W Magnolia St, Fort Collins, CO 80521
events.blurb: OpenStage Theatre & Company performs Steven Dietz’s gothic thriller adapted from Bram Stoker’s novel in the Magnolia Theatre. Includes theatrical violence and suspense.
events.blurbEs: OpenStage Theatre & Company presenta el thriller gótico de Steven Dietz basado en la novela de Bram Stoker en el Magnolia Theatre. Incluye violencia escénica y suspenso.

events.title: Dickens’ Holiday Spectacular
events.addr: 417 W Magnolia St, Fort Collins, CO 80521
events.blurb: High Country Conservatory of Dance mixes dancing toys, the Sugar Plum Fairy and Scrooge in a holiday show. A kids’ pre-show starts at 6 p.m. and the main show at 7 p.m.
events.blurbEs: High Country Conservatory of Dance combina juguetes que bailan, el Hada de Azúcar y Scrooge en un espectáculo navideño. Hay una función previa para niños a las 6 p. m. y el show principal a las 7 p. m.

events.title: Downtown Holiday Lights
events.addr: Old Town Square, Fort Collins, CO 80524
events.blurb: Trees throughout Old Town glow with thousands of LED bulbs from dusk, and the lights stay up through February.
events.blurbEs: Los árboles de Old Town brillan con miles de luces LED desde el atardecer, y se quedan encendidas hasta febrero.
